data.one_liner: Pure Dart Argon2 algorithm for password hashing across all platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart implementation of the Argon2 password hashing algorithm, allowing developers to generate cryptographic keys and hashes from passwords and salts on all Dart platforms including JS/Web, Flutter, and VM/Native.
use_when: You need to securely hash passwords using the Argon2 algorithm in a pure Dart environment.
Your application targets multiple platforms including Web, Native, and Flutter.
avoid_when: You only need standard hashing algorithms like SHA or MD5 already covered by the crypto package.
You prefer platform-specific native implementations for performance reasons.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation works across all platforms (JS/Web, Flutter, VM/Native).
Implements the winner of the Password Hash Competition 2015.
weaknesses: Pure Dart implementations of heavy crypto algorithms may be slower than native C bindings.
Limited documentation beyond the basic README example.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need standard cryptographic hash functions like SHA, MD5, or HMAC built for Dart.
